data.residual_risk: Five acceptance scenarios remain uncovered: malformed TOML, full default/installation/profile/CLI precedence, all enum variants, all unsupported options, and cross-platform/example-copy behavior. Linux/WSL profile paths and real API quality/model availability are also unverified.

scenarios.behavior: Positional text invokes translation and is sent only in the user message; stdout contains only the translation.
Piped UTF-8 stdin is translated while preserving source content sent to the provider.
Empty input or simultaneous positional text and stdin fails without request or partial stdout.
Missing default config falls back to built-in settings and valid explicit config replaces base settings.
Missing or invalid explicit config fails without partial output.
scenarios.evidence: Missing file and invalid semantic target were tested; malformed TOML syntax was not exercised, so this broad scenario remains incomplete.

scenarios.behavior: Profile selection uses the user config path and missing or invalid profiles fail.
Profile names reject path separators and traversal input.
Built-in defaults, installation config, profile, and explicit CLI overrides follow full precedence.
scenarios.evidence: Profile/CLI overlay was exercised; installation-directory config and complete precedence matrix were not run.

scenarios.behavior: Invalid source/target/mode/style/politeness/profanity enums, provider, timeout, and model fail.
scenarios.evidence: Provider, target, timeout, and empty configured model were tested; source/mode/style/politeness/profanity enum variants were not.

scenarios.behavior: Unicode, newlines, quotes, commands, and prompt-injection text remain untrusted user content separate from system instructions.
Missing credentials, authentication failure, rate limits, timeout, and invalid responses fail without source leakage or partial stdout.
Transient retry is bounded and failures emit no partial translation.
Help/version and successful/failed stream and exit-code behavior match the CLI contract.

scenarios.evidence: Only --clipboard was exercised; remaining unsupported flags were not individually tested.

scenarios.behavior: CLI runs without GUI dependencies and profile examples can be copied without overwriting existing user files.
scenarios.evidence: The process and sample-file existence were checked on Windows; Linux/WSL headless execution and actual copy/no-overwrite behavior were not exercised.
